description: Labeled corpus for ac-suggest measurability classifier (Epic #1299 AC5). Ground truth: `measurable` = a human agrees the AC anchors to a concrete evidence source the #1289 reconciler can check (file path / child #N / numeric metric / observable GitHub state). Aspirational phrasing (improve/better/robust/elegant, metric-word with no number) = not measurable. Feeds ac-suggest-replay-eval.js; the FP-rate <0.05 bar (AC5) is enforced as a regression gate.
provenance: Authored under #1299 reconciliation from the classifier's four evidence anchors + the cross-family review notes in #1302 (metric-word-without-number and check-in-double-check are honest negatives).
